pages.title: Building a Reactor
pages.text: The smallest reactor that works is a hollow $(thing)3 x 3 x 3$() box of casing with a single fuel rod inside.$(br2)Press the eye button on the next page to project the structure into the world, then build it block for block.

pages.name: Basic Passive Reactor
pages.text: Terminal on one wall, Access Port on another, Power Tap on a third. The Control Rod caps the fuel rod column from the top face.

pages.title: Making it bigger
pages.text: To scale up, grow the box and fill it. Every interior column is either a fuel rod capped with a control rod, or a moderator.$(br2)A good starting shape is a checkerboard: fuel rod columns with graphite between them, so radiation from one column passes through moderator before reaching the next.

pages.title: Turning it on
pages.text: Open the terminal, drop some uranium into the Access Port and hit the power button.$(br2)Control rod insertion starts at 0%. If the core temperature climbs faster than you would like, raise insertion until it settles.

pages.title: Going active
pages.text: The same box becomes an active reactor if you swap the Power Tap for a Coolant Port set to Inlet and add a second one set to Outlet.$(br2)Feed water into the inlet, take steam out of the outlet, and send it to a turbine.
